subject: english

knowledge.name: Teenage life 词汇
knowledge.explanation: hobby、club、volunteer work、exam、pressure、balance 等词汇是谈论青少年生活的基本词块。

knowledge.name: spend time doing 时间安排
knowledge.explanation: spend time (in) doing sth 表示花时间做某事，如 I spend an hour reading every day.；不要写成 spend time to read。

knowledge.name: should had better 建议
knowledge.explanation: should + 动词原形表建议；had better + 动词原形表较强制建议，否定为 had better not do。
prerequisites: spend time doing 时间安排

knowledge.name: more less 比较表达
knowledge.explanation: more time / less pressure 表示时间更多、压力更小；修饰不可数名词用 more/less，不用 fewer。

questions.analysis: volunteer work 指志愿工作；homework 作业、housework 家务、paperwork 文书工作，都不是志愿工作。

questions.stem: I spend half an hour （  ） English every morning.
questions.analysis: spend time doing sth 用动名词，A 正确；to read 不合结构，read、reads 缺 -ing。
questions.knowledge_point: spend time doing 时间安排

questions.stem: You （  ） （should） talk with your parents when you feel stressed.
questions.analysis: should 后接动词原形 talk，表示建议；题干括号已提示用 should，不需变形。

questions.stem: had better 的否定形式是 had better not do sth。
questions.analysis: had better not + 动词原形是标准否定结构，如 You had better not stay up late.，说法正确。

questions.stem: 「花更多时间运动、压力更小」的英文是（  ）
options: spend more time on sports and have less pressure
spend fewer time on sports and have less pressure
spend more time on sports and have fewer pressure
spend much time on sports and have little pressure
questions.analysis: time、pressure 都是不可数名词，用 more/less，A 正确；B fewer 修饰可数，C fewer pressure 搭配错，D 改变原意。

questions.stem: She spends two hours （  ） （practise） the violin every day.
questions.analysis: spend time doing 结构，practise 变 practising（去 e 加 ing）；英式拼写 practising。
questions.knowledge_point: spend time doing 时间安排

questions.stem: 下列属于青少年生活话题词的有（  ）
questions.analysis: A hobby 爱好 ✓；B exam 考试 ✓；C pressure 压力 ✓；D tractor 拖拉机，与青少年生活话题无关 ✗。故 A、B、C 成立，D 不成立。

questions.stem: spend time to do sth 是正确的结构。
questions.analysis: spend time 后接动名词，即 spend time (in) doing sth，用 to do 属于错误搭配。
questions.knowledge_point: spend time doing 时间安排

questions.stem: — I feel tired and I can't focus on my homework. — （  ）
options: You had better take a short break.
questions.analysis: 对方疲惫、注意力不集中，建议休息最合理，A 正确；B、C、D 都加重负担，不合交际逻辑。

questions.stem: You had better （  ） （not stay） up too late before an exam.
questions.analysis: had better not + 动词原形，所以填 not stay；写 not to stay 多了 to。

questions.stem: 关于比较表达，说法正确的有（  ）
options: more time 表示「更多时间」
questions.analysis: A more 可修饰不可数 ✓；B less 是 little 的比较级 ✓；C fewer 只修饰可数复数 ✗；D more time 表更多时间 ✓。故 A、B、D 成立，C 不成立。

questions.stem: less 是 little 的比较级，用于不可数名词。
questions.analysis: little 的比较级是 less，修饰不可数名词，如 less water、less pressure，说法正确。

options: He spends an hour playing basketball every day.
He spends an hour play basketball every day.
He spend an hour playing basketball every day.
He spends an hour to play basketball every day.
questions.analysis: spend time doing，主语 he 第三人称单数用 spends，A 正确；B 缺 -ing，C 缺 s，D 用 to do 结构错误。
questions.knowledge_point: spend time doing 时间安排

questions.stem: To keep a good balance, we should spend （  ） time on screens and more time on sports. （填「更少」）
questions.analysis: time 不可数，用 less；fewer 只能修饰可数复数。

questions.stem: You should to join a club to make new friends. 这句话正确。
questions.analysis: should 后直接接动词原形，不能加 to，应为 You should join a club…。

questions.stem: 用英语写三句话，谈谈你如何平衡学习与兴趣爱好，要求用上 spend time doing 和一个建议句型。

answer.value: I spend about an hour playing the piano every evening. I usually finish my homework first. You should plan your time carefully if you want to keep a hobby.

questions.analysis: 参考示例见答案。评分要点：①用 spend time doing（2 分）；②用 should / had better 给出建议（1 分）；③内容连贯、句子通顺（1 分）；④大小写与标点（1 分）。spend time to do 不得分。
questions.knowledge_point: spend time doing 时间安排

questions.stem: 把句子补全并译成中文：Teenagers today have （  ） （more） pressure than before, so they should spend （  ） （little） time on useless games.

answer.value: more；less。译文：如今的青少年比过去压力更大，所以他们应该在无用的游戏上花更少的时间。

questions.analysis: 参考答案：more（pressure 不可数，比较级用 more）；less（little 的比较级，修饰不可数 time）。译文见答案。评分要点：①两空正确（2 分）；②译文准确（2 分）；③标点（1 分）。第二空填 fewer 不得分。

questions.stem: 「参加社团能帮你缓解压力」的英文是（  ）
options: Joining a club can help you reduce pressure.
Join a club can help you reduce pressure.
Joining a club can helps you reduce pressure.
Joining a club can help you reduces pressure.
questions.analysis: 动名词 Joining 作主语，can 后接动词原形 help，A 正确；B 主语形式错，C can 后加 s，D help 后加 s，均不合语法。
